ADQSCIBC.AVISITN.CR-8.10.reason: Define-XML ADQSCIBC.AVISITN explicitly applies SAP windows to ADY, whose definition adds one on or after TRTSDT, while SAP page-11 uses plain date subtraction. SAP page-9 and ADSL.TRTSDT identify the common Visit-3 anchor, so the window-day definitions still disagree on and after that date.

ADQSCIBC.AVISITN.CR-5.reason: The documented ADY window rule does not describe how generated LOCF recipient records receive analysis visits. The literal probe re-windows carried donor dates and therefore demonstrates an incomplete applicability rule, not proof that recipient visits are incorrectly derived.

ADQSCIBC.AWRANGE.CR-10.reason: The retained original XML or governing SAP contains the rule, but the prior scalar adapter did not expose the complete value-level/source metadata. This is incomplete checker coverage, not an established documentation defect. SAP page-11 gives the interval cells for the CIBIC+ visits listed on page-15 (and the shared baseline cell, natively <=1), so AWRANGE can be probed as a mapping from AVISIT to those strings. Ordinary string rendering does not leave the rule incomplete; Pilot 6 adqscibc.r L121-L127 only shows the reference used the same cells.

ADQSCIBC.AWLO.CR-10.reason: The retained original XML or governing SAP contains the rule, but the prior scalar adapter did not expose the complete value-level/source metadata. This is incomplete checker coverage, not an established documentation defect. Define ADQSCIBC.AWLO, its integer type and SAP page-11 fix the starts of the finite CIBIC+ windows listed on page-15, including the first integer above 140. A missing start for an unbounded interval is its routine representation, so the rule is probeable; Pilot 6 adqscibc.r L121-L127 only shows the reference computed it that way.
